@@ -18,16 +18,20 @@ Supported models are:
 - embed-multilingual-v3.0
 - embed-english-light-v3.0
 - embed-multilingual-light-v3.0
-- embed-english-v2.0
-- embed-english-light-v2.0
-- embed-multilingual-v2.0
+
+The v2.0 models (`embed-english-v2.0`, `embed-english-light-v2.0` and `embed-multilingual-v2.0`) were retired by Cohere on April 4, 2026.
+
+The previous default, `embed-multilingual-v2.0`, produced 768-dimensional vectors.
+The new default, `embed-multilingual-v3.0`, produces 1024-dimensional vectors.
+Existing tables containing vectors from a v2.0 model must be re-embedded with an
+active model into a table whose vector column has the matching dimension.
 
 
 Supported parameters (to be passed in `create` method) are:
 
 | Parameter | Type | Default Value | Description |
 |---|---|--------|---------|
-| `name` | `str` | `"embed-english-v2.0"` | The model ID of the cohere model to use. Supported base models for Text Embeddings: embed-english-v3.0, embed-multilingual-v3.0, embed-english-light-v3.0, embed-multilingual-light-v3.0, embed-english-v2.0, embed-english-light-v2.0, embed-multilingual-v2.0 |
+| `name` | `str` | `"embed-multilingual-v3.0"` | The model ID of the cohere model to use. Supported base models for Text Embeddings: embed-english-v3.0, embed-multilingual-v3.0, embed-english-light-v3.0, embed-multilingual-light-v3.0 |
 | `source_input_type` | `str` | `"search_document"` | The type of input data to be used for the source column. |
 | `query_input_type` | `str` | `"search_query"` | The type of input data to be used for the query. |
